newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED ON MAJOR UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED ON MAJOR UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar ended a quiet Tuesday interbank session mixed against major currencies, holding steady on the U.S. unit, losing some ground to sterling and the rand but firming slightly on the mark.
"The market was relatively quiet. It was just one of those days where customers were not looking to doing anything apart from just one small import order," one broker said.

At Tuesday's close, the local unit was unmoved from its 10.7550/7750 late Monday position on the dollar but was indicated at 17.7491/7874 on sterling from 17.7100/7300 and at 2.2941/3008 on the rand from 2.2900/3100.
It, however, firmed marginally to 6.9279/9444 on the mark compared to 6.9300/9500.
